20261118-physics-e6.s.s1.explain: Si koronto u socoto, waa in la sameeyaa wareeg xiran (closed circuit) oo laga bilaabo hal pole battery-ga, ka dib marayo qaybaha korontada, ilaa pole-ka kale, iyada oo aan go'in.

20261122-physics-e6-1.goal: Apply principles of Haddii warqad wargeys ah ee xarfaha to solve the reasoning problem.
20261122-physics-e6-1.material: [Codsi sare] Haddii warqad wargeys ah ee xarfaha lagu eego lens magnifying (convex) aad u dhow, xarfuhu waa weyn yihiin oo toosan, laakiin marka la fogeeyo xarfuhu way is-rogaan. Maxay tahay sababta marka u dhow ay u toosan yihiin?
20261122-physics-e6-1.thinking.0: Haddii warqad wargeys ah ee xarfaha
20261122-physics-e6-1.s.s1.prompt: [Codsi sare] Haddii warqad wargeys ah ee xarfaha lagu eego lens magnifying (convex) aad u dhow, xarfuhu waa weyn yihiin oo toosan, laakiin marka la fogeeyo xarfuhu way is-rogaan. Maxay tahay sababta marka u dhow ay u toosan yihiin?
20261122-physics-e6-1.s.s1.explain: Marka walaxdu gudaha dhererka diirada lens-ka convex ku jirto, xariiqyada dheeraadka ah ee iftiinka leexday ayaa kulmaya oo waxay sameeyaan muuqaal virtual ah oo ka weyn walaxda oo toosan (virtual image weyn oo toosan).
20261122-physics-e6-1.s.s1.hint.0: Ka fikir jidka iftiinku u socdo marka walaxdu ka dhowdahay dhererka diirada.
20261122-physics-e6-1.s.s1.hint.1: Iftiinku wuu kala baxaa, sidaas darteed waa in laga sawiraa xariiqyo dib ah lens-ka dabadiisa si ay u kulmaan.
20261122-physics-e6-1.s.s1.o.o0: Sababtoo ah xarfuhu waxay ku jiraan gudaha dhererka diirada lens-ka, sidaas darteed waxaa la arkaa muuqaal virtual ah oo weyn oo toosan
20261122-physics-e6-1.s.s1.o.o1: Sababtoo ah iftiinku wuxuu u milicsamayaa sida muraayad dusha lens-ka
20261122-physics-e6-1.s.s1.o.o2: Sababtoo ah retina-ga indhuhu si ku meel gaar ah ayuu u weynaadaa
20261122-physics-e6-1.s.s1.o.o3: Sababtoo ah uumi ka mid ah hawada ayaa kululeysay lens-ka magnifying-ka

20261122-physics-e6-2.title: Waa maxay sababta cilmiga ee aan
20261122-physics-e6-2.topic: Waa maxay sababta cilmiga ee aan
20261122-physics-e6-2.goal: Apply principles of Waa maxay sababta cilmiga ee aan to solve the reasoning problem.
20261122-physics-e6-2.material: Waa maxay sababta cilmiga ee aan waligeed gacmaha qoyan loo taaban plug-ka korontada ama furaha qalabka guriga?
20261122-physics-e6-2.thinking.0: Waa maxay sababta cilmiga ee aan
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.prompt: Waa maxay sababta cilmiga ee aan waligeed gacmaha qoyan loo taaban plug-ka korontada ama furaha qalabka guriga?
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.explain: Marka maqaarku qoyo, iska caabbinta korontada ee jidhku si degdeg ah ayay hoos ugu dhacdaa ilaa tobanaan jibaar oo ka yar caadiga ah, sidaas darteed xitaa danab yar ayaa isku dhex mari kara jidhka koronto dhimasho ah oo keenta shoogga korontada.
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.hint.0: Si ka duwan biyaha saafiga ah, biyaha maalinlaha ah waxaa ku milmay electrolytes.
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.hint.1: Gacanta qoyan waxay si weyn u yaraysaa iska caabbinta maqaarka, sidaas darteed korontadu si fudud ayay u socotaa.
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.o.o0: Sababtoo ah ion-ka macdanta biyaha ku milmay ayaa korontada si fudud u gudbisa, waxaana xad-dhaaf u kordha khatarta korontada
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.o.o1: Sababtoo ah biyuhu waxay qaboojiyaan plug-ka oo waxay barafoobaan
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.o.o2: Sababtoo ah gacanta qoyan ayaa soo saarta xoog magnetic ah
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.o.o3: Sababtoo ah korontadu waxay kala uumiyaysaa dhammaan biyaha gacanta
